$comment: Base reload time per builder weapon id (no perks, no mods), for the sustained-DPS term of the firepower engine. reloadSeconds is the 'Reload' figure printed in the Technical section of the weapon's fallout.wiki infobox, quoted verbatim in `quote`; the page is `source`. null means the wiki prints no usable figure (`note: not published`), the weapon is melee/unarmed (`note: melee`) or the page was not fetched in this pass (`note: not fetched yet`); nothing is estimated. Uniques and alias ids carry `inheritedFrom` and copy their chassis entry. Perk numbers are the Patch 70 card texts in src/data/perk-cards.json.

gun-tricks.cardText: Your enhanced reflexes allow you to reload weapons 10/20/30% faster.

ground-pounder.cardText: Your small guns reload 10/20/30% faster and have 10/20/30% more hip fire accuracy.

quick-hands.cardText: Gain a 6/12/18% chance to instantly reload when your clip is empty.

wild-west-hands.cardText: 12/24/36% chance to instantly reload your entire magazine when empty.

lock-and-load.cardText: You keep half of your Bullet Storm stacks when you reload. +1% reload speed per stack.

guerrilla-expert.cardText: +1% reload speed per Onslaught stack, +3 max stacks.

fast-fighter.cardText: Gain 50% of your bonus movement speed as reload speed.
